tasks.subject: Task 1: Pillow + PyYAML deps + font
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add Pillow and PyYAML as runtime dependencies and vendor an open-licensed TTF as a package resource so text rendering is deterministic across platforms.

**Files:** pyproject.toml; src/bassify/render/__init__.py; src/bassify/render/fonts/{DejaVuSansMono.ttf,LICENSE,__init__.py}

**Acceptance Criteria:** pillow>=10 + pyyaml>=6 in deps; font as wheel package data; TTF loads; uv sync ok; PIL and yaml import.

**Verify:** uv sync && uv run python -c "import PIL, yaml; ...; print('ok')" -> ok

tasks.subject: Task 5: Key parse/detect/resolve
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Parse key string to root pitch-class, detect key via librosa, resolve effective key by precedence (--key > sidecar > detect).

**Files:** src/bassify/render/key.py; tests/test_render_key.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** NOTE_INDEX sharps+flats; root_pc parses E/Bm/F#m/Db, None on bad; resolve_key precedence cli>sidecar>detect, sidecar null forces neutral, detect not called when key present; detect_key returns pitch-class via librosa.

**Verify:** uv run pytest tests/test_render_key.py -v

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/bassify/render/key.py", "tests/test_render_key.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/test_render_key.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["NOTE_INDEX covers sharps + common flats", "root_pc parses E/Bm/F#m/Db, None on bad input", "resolve_key precedence cli>sidecar>detect", "sidecar key:null forces neutral; detect not called when key present", "detect_key returns pitch-class via librosa"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 10: CLI render command + integration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire bassify render into the CLI (single->error fast; dir->batch; --key + knob flags; slice-first nudge), add justfile passthrough + clean, and prove end-to-end with ffmpeg + librosa.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** Requested by the user ("prove the whole thing end-to-end"). MUST NOT be closed by walking around it or substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every acceptanceCriteria is re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:** src/bassify/cli.py; justfile; tests/test_render_integration.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** render command with all flags incl --key; single-file missing bass.wav exits non-zero with expected message; directory arg batches with skip summary; final w/o slice prints slice-first tip; just render works + just clean removes axis/wave/cover; integration: still+final valid MP4 video+audio yuv420p, thumbnail 1280x720, vdur==adur, error-fast raises, detect_key returns pitch-class.
